semiconductor_relevance: High — Kurt J. Lesker Company specializes in vacuum technology solutions critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Kurt J. Lesker Company is a leading manufacturer and distributor of high vacuum and ultra-high vacuum systems, essential for semiconductor fabrication and research applications. They provide a wide range of products including vacuum chambers, pumps, and thin film sources, supporting various semiconductor processes.
capabilities: High vacuum and ultra-high vacuum systems

regional_presence.China: Kurt J. Lesker Company has its Asia headquarters in Shanghai, facilitating customer engagement and inventory distribution across Asia.
regional_presence.Europe: The company operates a European Distribution Centre in Dresden, Germany, serving customers throughout Europe.
regional_presence.United States: The headquarters is located in Pittsburgh, PA, housing a significant workforce and manufacturing capabilities.
